name: Runner Extras - Test Data Hydration (local, needs a BC backup)
brief: End-to-end proof that --test-data hydrates real rows from a BC .bak and AL reads them back.
description: NOT RUN BY CI — see README.md. This bundle only passes when the runner is invoked with --test-data and a BC sandbox backup is present, which no CI leg has (the artifact is ~1 GB). It lives outside tests/runner-extras/ for exactly that reason: that directory is run wholesale, without the flag, on every matrix leg.
